# 👷 Jenkins CI/CD Pipelines & Automation Mastery Track

Welcome to the **Jenkins CI/CD Pipelines & Automation Mastery Track** materialized by **Trak**.

This workspace is an in-depth curriculum covering Jenkins Controller-Agent distributed architecture, Declarative Pipeline-as-Code (`Jenkinsfile`), Docker container agents, Shared Libraries, Credentials masking, Multibranch indexing, and JCasC (Jenkins Configuration-as-Code).

## 📚 Syllabus & Module Map

| Module | Title | Key Topics & Internals |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `00-setup-and-jenkins-architecture` | Controller & Agent Architecture | Controller (Master), JNLP/Inbound agents, `JENKINS_HOME` directory layout |
| `01-freestyle-vs-pipeline-jobs` | Pipeline-as-Code | UI Freestyle legacy vs version-controlled `Jenkinsfile` in Git repositories |
| `02-declarative-pipeline-syntax` | Declarative Pipeline Syntax | Mandatory sections (`pipeline`, `agent`, `stages`, `steps`, `post`) |
| `03-scripted-pipeline-and-groovy` | Scripted Pipelines & Groovy | Node blocks, Groovy syntax, `script {}` blocks inside Declarative stages |
| `04-agent-directives-and-docker-nodes` | Docker Agents & Execution | `agent { docker { image '...' } }`, ephemeral isolated container builds |
| `05-stages-steps-and-parallel-execution` | Parallel Execution | `parallel { stage('Test 1') {} stage('Test 2') {} }`, `failFast: true` |
| `06-environment-variables-and-parameters` | Environment & Parameters | `environment {}`, `parameters { string() }`, `params.ENV_NAME` |
| `07-credentials-and-secret-masking` | Credentials & Masking | `withCredentials([string(...)])`, Secret text, SSH keys, masking in logs |
| `08-post-actions-and-notifications` | Post Actions & Webhooks | `post { always, success, failure, cleanup }`, Slack notifications, email |
| `09-when-conditions-and-branch-filtering` | `when` Flow Control | `when { branch 'main' }`, `when { tag 'v*' }`, `beforeAgent true` optimization |
| `10-shared-libraries-and-reusable-groovy` | Jenkins Shared Libraries | Reusable `@Library('my-lib') _`, `vars/myStep.groovy`, `src/` classes |
| `11-multibranch-pipelines-and-git-branch-discovery` | Multibranch Pipelines | Automatic branch indexing, PR status checks, branch webhook discovery |
| `12-build-triggers-and-webhooks` | Triggers & Polling | GitHub push webhooks, cron expressions (`H/15 * * * *`), upstream triggers |
| `13-artifacts-and-test-reports` | Artifacts & Test Reports | `archiveArtifacts`, fingerprinting, JUnit XML test report publishing |
| `14-input-steps-and-manual-approval` | Manual Approval Gates | `input { message 'Deploy?' submitter 'leads' }`, timeout cancellation |
| `15-jenkins-configuration-as-code-jcasc` | JCasC (`jenkins.yaml`) | Headless Controller configuration, automated plugin bootstrapping |
| `16-security-rbac-and-audit-logging` | Security & RBAC | Role Strategy Plugin, Matrix Security, CSRF crumbs, audit logs |
| `17-performance-tuning-and-garbage-collection` | Tuning & GC Optimization | Controller JVM G1GC tuning, `buildDiscarder`, workspace cleanup (`cleanWs`) |
| `18-interview-questions-and-drills` | Interview Mastery Drills | Top 10 Jenkins CI/CD gotchas + Production Multi-Stage Deployment Drill |

---

## 🛠️ How to Practice
Each module contains:
- `README.md` — Deep theoretical explanation and architecture notes.
- `Jenkinsfile` / `pipeline.groovy` — Fully runnable concept demonstration.
- `exercise/starter.groovy` — Hands-on problem with `TODO` markers.
- `exercise/solution.groovy` — Complete reference solution.

# 18 — High-Yield Jenkins CI/CD Interview Drills

## 🧠 Top 10 Gotchas
1. **Builds on Controller Node**: Running heavy builds on Controller risks JVM heap exhaustion and whole-cluster crashes.
2. **Declarative vs Scripted**: Declarative provides strict validation and visual Blue Ocean pipelines; Scripted offers raw Groovy power.
3. **`withCredentials` Scope**: Secrets are only available within the block and are masked in console output.
4. **`beforeAgent true` Efficiency**: Evaluates branch filters without waiting for worker agent provisioning.
5. **Shared Library Security**: Changes to shared libraries apply immediately to all pipelines referencing `@Library('main')`.
6. **Zombie Workspace Disk Bloat**: Without `cleanWs()`, stale node_modules and Docker layers fill worker agent disks.
7. **Non-CPS Methods in Groovy**: Groovy methods containing closures or non-serializable objects require `@NonCPS`.
8. **Pipeline Serialization**: Jenkins persists pipeline execution state to disk after every step (CPS - Continuation Passing Style).
9. **Agent Disconnects**: Inbound agents require resilient heartbeat and automatic restart systemd service.
10. **Webhook Replay Attacks**: Always configure shared secret HMAC signatures in GitHub webhook configurations.
